name: compress
description: Gzips pages, data and JSON for clients that accept it, flushing streamed responses as they go.
author: Tern

name: cors
description: Lets other origins call the app's endpoints, with preflight requests answered.
notes: Set the origins that may call the app in main.go.
author: Tern

name: health
description: Liveness and readiness endpoints, /healthz and /readyz, for load balancers and orchestrators.
author: Tern

name: images
description: Resizes remote images for <Image src="https://…">, with a disk cache.
notes: List the hosts images may come from in main.go.
author: Tern

name: metrics
description: Prometheus metrics at /metrics: requests by route and status, their durations, and the Go runtime.
author: Tern

name: ratelimit
description: Limits how often each client changes things, such as form actions and API writes, with 429 and Retry-After past the limit.
author: Tern

name: requestlog
description: Logs every request with slog: method, path, status, time and the request's ID.
author: Tern

name: secure
description: Security headers on every response: no framing by other sites, trimmed referrers, powerful browser features off, and HSTS when asked.
author: Tern

name: sessions
description: Per-user data in an encrypted, signed cookie.
notes: Set SESSION_SECRET to at least 32 random characters, such as from openssl rand -hex 32.
author: Tern

name: signals
description: Tells people from bots and recognizes devices, from TLS and HTTP fingerprints and a client check.
author: Tern

name: oauth
description: Sign in with GitHub, Google or any OpenID Connect provider.
notes: It needs each provider's client ID and secret: see the docs for the options.
author: Tern

name: oidc
description: Makes the app an OAuth 2.1 and OpenID Connect provider, with consent, for other apps and assistants.
notes: It needs an issuer URL, a store and its clients: see the docs for the options.
author: Tern
